claims.claim_atom: Re-running the meta-analysis from the summary statistics extracted from Zhao et al. (2023) Figure 4 (random-effects DerSimonian-Laird, A-Tjak 2018 excluded, 10 studies) reproduces a pooled standardized mean difference of Hedges g = -1.05, and this point estimate lies within its own reported 95% CI [-1.44, -0.66].
claims._note: GROUNDING: Figure 4 是排除 A-Tjak 2018 后的 10 项敏感性分析, 合并 SMD=-1.052 ∈ [-1.4447, -0.6593], 与论文报告 d=-1.05, 95%CI[-1.44,-0.66] 一致. FP陷阱: Zhao 正文写 'eleven studies/887 patients' (对应 all11 行 est=-0.7548), 但 Figure 4 实为 10 项; 若误取 11 项行会错判 inconsistent. 须定位对的行(模型).

claims.claim_atom: After correcting the three data-extraction errors identified in the re-extraction and re-running Zhao et al.'s analytic workflow (re-extracted effect sizes, duplicate Ren Zhihong 2012 removed, outlier Zemestani 2020 excluded; 9 studies), the corrected pooled effect (g = -0.61) is substantially smaller in magnitude than the Figure-4 reproduction (g = -1.05).
claims._note: GROUNDING: 修正后最终模型 est=-0.6065 vs Figure4 est=-1.0520 → |−0.6065|/|−1.0520|−1 = −42.3%, 与 notebook 报告 '42.3% smaller' 一致. 须区分 4 个不同合并估计(-0.7548 / -1.0520 / -0.7831 / -0.6065), 只有 final 与 fig4 两行对得上此断言.

claims.claim_atom: Heterogeneity in the full 11-study model is very high (I^2 = 93.1%, consistent with Zhao's reported I^2 = 93%) and is higher than in the Figure-4 sensitivity model after excluding the influential study A-Tjak 2018 (I^2 = 84.0%).
claims._note: GROUNDING: all11 I2=93.1 复现 Zhao 正文 I2=93%; 排除 A-Tjak 后 I2 降至 84.0, 佐证其为影响力离群点. 须把两个 I^2 分别对到正确模型行, 别张冠李戴.

claims.claim_atom: Whether the three 'indeterminable' studies' summary statistics are accurate cannot be established from the deposited artifacts, because the original source articles were inaccessible (Chinese-language pay-walled or no locatable DOI); the re-extracted pooled estimate assumes them correct.
claims._note: INSUFFICIENT: notebook 明说 3 项研究原文不可获取(仅中文付费/无 DOI), 其提取值在 liberal 假设下当作正确纳入. 部署 artifacts 无法证实或证伪这 3 项, 故 insufficient — 非造假, 而是可核验证据缺失.

metadata._lane: 诚实可复现论文(验证报告, 非造假); 全部实质 claim=consistent + 1 insufficient(证据缺失非冲突). 考 AI 从森林图/多个合并模型中定位对的合并效应量, 并抵抗 FP 误判(11 vs 10 项, 4 个不同 SMD 估计)
